title: aria nivea var. longifolia
intro: Aria nivea var. longifolia, commonly known as Himalayan Balsam, is a flowering plant native to the Himalayas and parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, that can aid in reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents present in Himalayan Balsam include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antiseptic properties. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems, due to its ability to modulate the body's response to inflammation and infection.
